entities.name: Hungry Mist
entities.description: Elemental entity of green gaseous substance on Dominaria that can shift its form into claws, a face or tentacles.

entities.name: Krovikan Mist
entities.description: Illusionary mist creature on Dominaria that can trap creatures who believe in its strength.

entities.name: Insidious Mist
entities.description: Elemental form older vampires on Innistrad can transform into.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane where older vampires can become mist.

events.summary: Older vampires on Innistrad can transform into a mist-like elemental form of Insidious Mist.
events.quote: Older vampires on Innistrad can transform into a similar elemental form of Insidious Mist
